project: NEFF — independence-weighted fact verification on Gonka
rule: passes flips to true ONLY after qa-tester exercises the capability end-to-end against the running app. Never on code review alone.

features.action: User pastes a plain-text claim into the input on the home screen and presses Verify.
features.expected: The app accepts it, shows a live verification run, and reaches a final verdict without error.
features.evidence: E:/Projects/GONKA_TRACK/evidence/qa/F1-report-full.png — typed/one-click claim "Taking vitamin C supplements prevents the common cold." in headless Chrome, run streamed to completion, verdict 24/100 LEANS FALSE, permalink /r/yz3p8tzuwjrs, zero console errors.

features.action: User pastes a public article URL instead of text and presses Verify.
features.expected: The server fetches the page, extracts the central checkable claim, displays the extracted claim back to the user for confirmation, and verifies that claim.
features.evidence: E:/Projects/GONKA_TRACK/evidence/qa/f2url/live-mid-run.png + E:/Projects/GONKA_TRACK/evidence/qa/F2-live-url-run.png — typed https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Krakatoa into the box and clicked Verify in headless Chrome: stage line "Probing 3 models…" with the extracted claim "The 1883 eruption of Krakatoa had a volcanic explosivity index of 6." displayed above the probe grid before any verdict; run completed in 74s, permalink /r/j9k38jrtz7cg, zero console errors. Separately POST {"input":"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mariana_Trench"} to /api/verify streamed stage "prep — Fetching the page and isolating the checkable claim", then prep event {claim:"The Mariana Trench is the deepest oceanic trench on Earth.", sourceUrl, sourceTitle:"Mariana Trench - Wikipedia"} and verdict 86/100 SUPPORTED (/r/yy5dn6kjyhy7, rendered with "EXTRACTED FROM A LINK" and a clickable Source link). Home-page chip "a linked article" also runs the Streisand URL path end to end (/r/zdp2td7hsbdm).

features.action: Any verification is run.
features.expected: 100% of inference calls go to api.gonkarouter.io. No other model provider is called anywhere in the codebase. Verifiable by grep and by the receipt ledger.
features.evidence: grep over app/lib/components/test/tools/init.sh finds exactly one inference host, https://api.gonkarouter.io (lib/gonka.ts); no openai/anthropic/gemini/mistral/cohere/groq/together/ollama host or SDK anywhere (package.json deps are next/react/react-dom/server-only only). Live run yz3p8tzuwjrs ledger shows 11/11 inferences with Gonka request ids req-1788493591599683808-629002 … -629033 on nodes 70951/70701/70917/70711/70726/70936/70944. Evidence: E:/Projects/GONKA_TRACK/evidence/qa/F1-report-full.png

features.action: User runs a verification and opens the panel view.
features.expected: All three Gonka models (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, MiniMax-M2.7, Kimi-K2.6) return a direct verdict, each shown separately with its own stance and confidence.
features.evidence: E:/Projects/GONKA_TRACK/evidence/qa/F1-report-full.png — panel shows DeepSeek V4 Flash REFUTED conf 0.95, MiniMax M2.7 REFUTED conf 0.88, Kimi K2.6 REFUTED conf 0.85, each in its own card with its own reasoning.

features.action: User runs a verification on a claim all models agree on.
features.expected: The app reports nominal consensus (e.g. 3/3) AND a separately computed Effective Witness Count below the nominal count, with the discount explained in plain language.
features.evidence: E:/Projects/GONKA_TRACK/evidence/qa/F1-report-full.png — "NOMINAL CONSENSUS — WHAT A VOTE WOULD SHOW 3/3" beside "EFFECTIVE WITNESSES — WHAT IT IS ACTUALLY WORTH 1.1", explained as "1.9 of 3 apparent witnesses did not survive: 1.9 to redundancy, 89% measured overlap in the evidence the agreeing models lean on".

features.action: User inspects a model that failed the mirror probe.
features.expected: The UI shows that the model affirmed both the claim and its negation, quotes both answers side by side, and shows that model's vote weight discounted toward zero as a result.
features.evidence: E:/Projects/GONKA_TRACK/evidence/qa/F6-kimi-card.png (+ F6-mirror-full.png, F6-kimi-zoom.png) — /r/mywty8firb rendered in headless Chrome: Kimi K2.6 card is tagged "ECHO — FAILED THE MIRROR PROBE" with the two probe answers stacked side by side, "on the claim SUPPORTED" / "on its negation SUPPORTED", the note "Returned SUPPORTED for both the claim and its negation. It is responding to the shape of the sentence, not to the fact, so its vote is discounted to zero", and "vote weight 0.00". The verdict panel carries a VOTE THROWN OUT callout naming Kimi K2.6, and the effective witness meter drops 3/3 → 1.0.

features.action: User inspects the evidence-anchor breakdown.
features.expected: The app lists the concrete sources each model leaned on, marks anchors shared across models, and shows the shared-source penalty applied to the Effective Witness Count.
features.evidence: E:/Projects/GONKA_TRACK/evidence/qa/F1-report-full.png — each model card lists its named sources under EVIDENCE IT LEANED ON and is tagged "shares this evidence base with …"; the 89% measured overlap and the 1.9-witness redundancy penalty are stated on the Effective Witnesses meter.

features.action: User runs a verification where the models disagree with each other.
features.expected: The app does not average the disagreement away: it names the split, identifies the specific point of contention, and lowers confidence rather than reporting a misleading mid-range score.
features.evidence: E:/Projects/GONKA_TRACK/evidence/qa/F8-split.png — /r/sf6mcc6r4e ("Iceland has no mosquitoes") rendered in headless Chrome: verdict panel states "The panel is split. 2/3 took the leading position, worth 1.2 independent witnesses once the dissent is priced in" (nominal 2/3 vs 1.2 effective); a "WHERE THE PANEL SPLITS" card names the contention — "whether the absence of mosquitoes in Iceland is documented by authoritative, specific scientific sources: the supporting models cited such sources, while the uncertain model could not name a definitive study"; MiniMax M2.7 is shown dissenting UNCERTAIN, "PARTIAL — DECISIVE ON ONE SIDE ONLY", vote weight 0.50. Score is 74/100 LEANS TRUE with the band widened to ±23 (vs ±14 on the 3/3 unanimous run yy5dn6kjyhy7) — confidence lowered, not averaged to a mid-range 50.

features.action: User reads the final report.
features.expected: A Truth Score from 0 to 100 is displayed with an explicit verdict label and an uncertainty band derived from the Effective Witness Count.
features.evidence: E:/Projects/GONKA_TRACK/evidence/qa/F1-report-full.png — "24/100", "± 24 credible band", label LEANS FALSE; band = 50 × (1 − EWC/(EWC+1)), confirmed across 7 stored runs (EWC 3 → ±13, EWC 1.0 → ±25).

features.action: User opens the reasoning trace.
features.expected: Every inference step is listed in order — probe type, model, prompt intent, and the model's own reasoning — readable end to end without opening devtools.
features.evidence: E:/Projects/GONKA_TRACK/evidence/qa/F13-receipt-expanded-full.png — receipt ledger lists all 11 inference steps in order with STEP (claim preparation / claim, as stated / claim, negated (blind) / evidence anchors / closing adjudication), MODEL, latency and tokens; clicking a row reveals REQUEST SENT TO GONKAROUTER.IO (full prompt) and RAW RESPONSE FROM THE NODE. No devtools needed.

features.action: User looks for what would change the verdict.
features.expected: The report names the single load-bearing fact the verdict depends on and states explicitly what evidence would flip it.
features.evidence: E:/Projects/GONKA_TRACK/evidence/qa/F1-report-full.png — "What this rests on" panel: LOAD-BEARING FACT = "The 2013 Cochrane review by Hemilä and Chalker, pooling 29 placebo-controlled trials, found that regular vitamin C supplementation does not reduce the incidence of colds in the general population"; WHAT WOULD FLIP IT = "A new, well-conducted meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials showing a statistically significant reduction in cold incidence among the general population taking vitamin C…".

features.action: User opens the Receipt Ledger.
features.expected: Every Gonka inference in the run is listed with its Gonka Request ID, serving devshard node ID, model, latency and token usage. IDs are copyable.
features.evidence: E:/Projects/GONKA_TRACK/evidence/qa/F12-copy-clicked.png — ledger columns NODE / GONKA REQUEST ID / MODEL / STEP / LATENCY / TOKENS for all 11 inferences; clicking COPY REQUEST ID flips the label to "copied" and navigator.clipboard.readText() returned req-1788493591599683808-629002.

features.action: User clicks a single receipt row.
features.expected: The exact request sent and the raw response received for that Gonka Request ID are shown, so the verdict is auditable step by step.
features.evidence: E:/Projects/GONKA_TRACK/evidence/qa/F13-receipt-expanded.png — clicked the MiniMax "claim, as stated" row on /r/yz3p8tzuwjrs; expansion shows SERVED BY NODE 70701 · ENGINE VLLM-0.25.1-TP4-FA0C6C4C · FINISH STOP, the exact request JSON, and the raw node response including the model chain of thought.

features.action: User watches a verification while it runs.
features.expected: Probe results and receipts stream in live as each Gonka node responds, rather than appearing all at once at the end.
features.evidence: E:/Projects/GONKA_TRACK/evidence/qa/F14-live-t4s.png — 4s into the run the page reads "Probing 3 models three ways each, in parallel across Gonka nodes · 9 of 11 inferences returned" with filled probe cells and one cell still "awaiting node…"; by t=10s all cells resolved, verdict at ~20s.

features.action: One Gonka model is unreachable or times out during a run.
features.expected: The run completes on the remaining models, the failure is shown honestly in the ledger, and the Effective Witness Count drops to reflect the lost verifier.
features.evidence: E:/Projects/GONKA_TRACK/evidence/qa/F15-timeout-run.png — /r/i2mna7iu7v36 (a real run where Kimi timed out): panel card shows NO ANSWER / "Timed out after 60s", vote weight 0.00, "This Gonka node did not return a usable answer, so the panel is one witness short"; ledger has two "no response" rows and the footer reads "11 inferences on Gonka · 6,731 tokens · 102.3s wall clock · 6 distinct nodes · 2 failed, shown honestly above"; nominal consensus falls to 2/2 and EWC to 1.4. Timeout occurred organically, not induced by QA.

features.action: A judge lands on the app for the first time with no explanation.

features.evidence: E:/Projects/GONKA_TRACK/evidence/qa/F16-landing.png — first screen states "Independence-weighted fact verification · every inference on Gonka" plus the one-line thesis "Three models agreeing is one witness if they all read the same page"; four TRY chips; clicking "vitamin C prevents colds" filled the box and produced a full verdict with no docs read.

features.action: A Gonka node spends its whole token budget inside its chain of thought and never writes the answer.
features.expected: The probe is retried with a larger budget, and if it still fails the model's own draft of the answer is recovered from its reasoning and labelled as recovered — never invented, never silently dropped.
features.evidence: Two kinds of evidence, both personally run. (1) Replayed-capture: `npm test` — "a probe whose answer never arrived is recovered from the model's own draft" (test/recovery.test.ts) PASS, plus all of test/salvage.test.ts (recovery-requires-the-asked-field, complete-answer-never-treated-as-draft, etc.) PASS, 77/77 total. (2) Live: `npm run test:live` test/live/salvage.test.ts against the real router with MiniMax starved to 400 tokens — "a node that runs out of tokens is asked again with more of them" PASS (41.3s) and "a starved probe that cannot be recovered still keeps the node's reasoning" PASS (10.1s). Additionally, an actual browser-driven run (evidence/iteration/live-mid-run.png / report-full.png, stored at .runs/pi6uzntv9fd7.json) hit this failure mode live: a Kimi mirror probe returned rawResponse "<think>" only (error "the node returned reasoning but no answer", attempts=3) — since no draft existed, it correctly errored rather than inventing an answer, consistent with the never-invented requirement.

features.action: A probe times out against the router.
features.expected: It is sent again inside the same phase budget rather than written off, because the router serves the finished completion to the next identical request.
features.evidence: Two kinds of evidence, both personally run. (1) Replayed-capture: `npm test` test/retry.test.ts — "a timeout is retried, and retried immediately" PASS, "the same call does retry when the budget has room for it" PASS, "a caller that has gone away is never retried" PASS, "a backoff never sleeps past the deadline it was given" PASS. (2) Live: the same browser-driven run above (.runs/pi6uzntv9fd7.json) recorded a real live timeout retried inside its phase budget — receipt for DeepSeek's anchor probe: attempts=3, error "Timed out after 9s" — i.e. the router timed out and the app re-sent the same probe twice more before giving up, exactly the mechanism under test.

features.action: A verification is running and the reader watches the central sphere.
features.expected: The sphere itself shows the work: a seat per probe lighting as its node answers, and a sweep behind them. No static loading text.
features.evidence: tools/live-ui-check.mjs replaying a stored run into the running app (no Gonka calls), plus tools/browser-check.mjs on a live verification. Screenshot evidence/iteration/live-half-filled.png at four of nine probes landed: four seats lit with white cores, five dark, in the out-of-order positions the real arrival order produced. The animation query reports orbs-module__seatWait x5 (one per waiting seat), orbs-module__coreBody, coreHalo and corePulse — and the centre of the sphere reads null, i.e. no text at all while probes are out.

features.action: A judge asks where the numbers in the truth score come from.
features.expected: The arithmetic cell opens a derivation labelling every constant as a definition, a published standard with its source, or a choice with its reasoning and the direction it errs.
features.evidence: MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 SHOT_CLICK_TEXT="where these numbers come from" node tools/shot.mjs evidence/iteration arith /r/38e66az5d288 — evidence/iteration/arith.png, on a report with real numbers (19/100 REFUTED, 1.7 effective witnesses). The opened derivation labels every constant DEFINITION, STANDARD or CHOSEN: the two 50s and balance and band as definitions of the 0-100 scale; the n/(n+1) shrinkage and Kish 1965 as standards with sources named; and the two choices, the kappa=1 prior and the 0.6 anchor containment threshold, each with its reasoning and the direction it errs. The threshold entry quotes the sweep over the 534 anchor pairs stored at the time, and npm run sweep:threshold reproduces it from .runs/ with no Gonka calls. Verified against the shipped copy after the figures were re-measured; an earlier capture of the same panel quoted 243 pairs, which was the corpus size then.
